messages.subject: Who should join this group?
parts:
If you have or will ever use the matR package for R, this is the forum for you.

If you don't know what matR is, see the "what is matR" post

If you don't know about matR, but are conducting metagenomic research, this is also the group for you.

matR is a tool that makes analysis of metagenomic data ( functional annotation abundance data in particular )
much simpler than is currently the case.

There is not much content here yet.

Please feel free to join and start a topic.
 
I'm particularly interested addressing questions related to analyses that you'd
like to try with matR.

Cheers
Kevin
